verdict.rationale: Event subscription via webhooks is a fair axis for an agent product that runs headless in CI pipelines, so the story applies. The evidence shows no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The headless mode streams session events as JSON Lines on stdout, which is a local process-output stream rather than a webhook a programmatic consumer can subscribe to. That is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
